document_name: ASSEMBLE THE PRINTED LEG - centred DFM parts

stages.title: 1. Prepare the yaw servo base
stages.note: Not on overnight plate: saddle and yaw cap. Three M3x30 with nuts and one flat washer each.

stages.title: 2. Fit the yaw discs and upper coxa
stages.note: Matching centre retainers first. Main horn: four M3x6, one 0.5 mm washer per screw.

stages.title: 3. Clamp the hip servo
stages.note: Load two post nuts through side slots now. Hip case: three M3x30 with nuts and one washer each.

stages.title: 4. Fit the yaw spacers and lower arm
stages.note: Four 11.6 mm spacers. Disc: four M3x20 with two washers. Post: two M3x20 with one washer.

stages.title: 5. Attach the main femur bracket
stages.note: Fit hip discs and retainers. Main horn: four M3x6 with one washer each. Load the bridge nut.

stages.title: 6. Clamp the knee servo
stages.note: Case points back toward hip. Three M3x30 with nuts and one flat washer per screw.

stages.title: 7. Close the femur fork
stages.note: Annular stand-off faces inward. Four M3x12 with TWO washers; one M3x30 into bridge nut.

stages.title: 8. Attach the straight tibia
stages.note: Fit knee discs and retainers. Main horn: four M3x6 with one washer each. Load both bridge nuts.

stages.title: 9. Close the tibia fork
stages.note: Four M3x12 with TWO washers; two M3x30 with one washer each into the two bridge nuts.

scope: Exact CAD pieces animated in Fusion using explanatory exploded translations. Hardware quantities appear in captions; screws, nuts, washers and cables are not drawn. Exploded paths are illustrative, not a collision-tested installation path. Saved F3D files are the exploded and assembled states, not an Animation-workspace storyboard. No hardware actuation.
